key_insight: El Agente Potente turns high-level materials science goals into reliable atomistic simulation workflows by combining LLM-based planning with deterministic, provenance-aware execution.
engineering_relevance: It enables high-throughput property calculations and customized atomistic studies with controlled, auditable automation for materials discovery and catalysis.
method: Typed execution graphs separate LLM planning/routing from deterministic scientific computation and validation.
A complementary coding agent builds custom workflows for flexible tasks while reusing existing Potente simulation functions.
Designed for MLIP-driven simulations across materials discovery, energy landscapes, adsorption, and reaction workflows.
evidence_signal: The paper reports systematic benchmarks of reproducibility and LLM token cost across several atomistic simulation workflows.
watch_item: Flexible coding-based workflow construction may increase implementation complexity and still requires careful validation to preserve scientific rigor.
paper_title: El Agente Potente: High-Throughput Agentic Atomistic Simulations
